name: 33486 · Boca Raton, FL
findings: ZIP 33486 (Boca Raton) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33486 (Boca Raton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
58% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
